description:
## Summary

The opaque `{id, display}` handle shape is retained, but its semantics move from the commons FORGE-CAPABILITY.md contract to a Groundwork-owned Radicle identity definition: a complete, scoped identity naming the repository (RID) and the collaborative-object OID it refers to. The completeness-and-scope identity discipline established by commons ADR-0017 survives, re-homed here. This is the contract seam every other unit in the arc references.

Part of: #538.

## Scope

- The normative home of the Radicle identity definition (docs/schemas)
- `schemas/work-unit.schema.json` and `schemas/change-proposal.schema.json` handle semantics
- Conformance handle validation; fixtures and tests

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A Groundwork-owned normative definition of work-unit and change-proposal identity exists: complete (repository RID plus COB OID; revision-qualified where a specific revision is the referent) and scoped (identity is validated for completeness and scope before any operation consumes it).
- [ ] The work-unit and change-proposal schemas' handle semantics reference the Groundwork home as authority; no schema or prose names FORGE-CAPABILITY.md as the governing contract.
- [ ] Conformance validates artifact handles against the new grammar — the handle-drift gate protects agreement with the Groundwork definition instead of the vendored contract — and valid/invalid fixtures cover acceptance of well-formed Radicle identities and rejection of malformed or foreign ones.
- [ ] The schema index and the docs that describe the handle seam state the new authority.

## Contract inputs

- **Behavior:** validation accepts complete scoped Radicle identities and rejects incomplete/foreign ones, proven by fixtures.
- **Documentation:** the schema index is where an artifact author first meets handle semantics — it must answer standalone.
- **Code quality:** Traceability — one authority for identity, no second home (`~/.groundwork/principles/`).

## Dependencies

Depends on: #597 (decision home), #596 (identity/OID semantics verified on the installed surface).

## Out of scope

- Submission version-to-revision binding semantics (the submit unit)
- Acquisition state vocabulary (the acquire unit)
